speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe which specific joints are painful and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been experiencing pain in my left big toe, hips, and knees for several years now. The discomfort has been gradually getting worse over time, but it really flares up when I am active and eases up when I rest. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of pain worsening with activity and improving with rest is highly suggestive of osteoarthritis rather than an inflammatory condition. I will confirm this with imaging and lab work to rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_of_affected_joints; REQUEST TEST: Serum_Uric_Acid_Level; REQUEST TEST: ESR_and_CRP

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hip and Knee X-Rays: Joint space narrowing with osteophyte formation, suggestive of osteoarthritis. Uric Acid Level: 6 mg/dL. ESR and CRP: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging confirms osteoarthritis, and the normal inflammatory markers and uric acid levels rule out gout and inflammatory arthritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis
